title: Run the season forward: measure first, drives last
takeaway: Move the work to the months where it still changes the outcome, so the drives themselves are only logistics.
sources: You cannot plan for a batch you have not measured.
By then the calendar has already decided the outcome.
Mock interviews do the most good before the season, not during it.
The months below assume a season that opens around the start of the final year.

events.label: Readiness baseline
events.note: one identical hour for every student, shared with heads of department

events.label: Resume clinics, projects
events.note: one written standard; chase students with no project

events.label: Mock interviews, first pass
events.note: structured, same questions for the whole batch

events.label: Drive logistics
events.note: eligibility lists, one calendar, tested labs

events.label: One page per department
events.note: next year's plan starts from it
